content.text: Almost. Theo is 5 months, and Canadian guidance says to start solids around 6 months. Until then, breast milk or formula is still all he needs. Watch for the readiness signs now: sitting with support, steady head control, reaching for your food, and opening his mouth when a spoon comes near. When he's about 6 months, iron-rich foods like meat, tofu or iron-fortified cereal are the first things to offer. Your provider can confirm the timing for him.
